messages:
anya: Heads-up: starting a focused cleanup of errref pages related to 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks. Found a few stale links and older SDK snippets that don't follow the unified retry-header pattern. Ill open a PR to consolidate examples, add a tiny smoke test, and include migration notes for Dedicated/private users.

sam: Thanks  any ETA and a short list of the affected files?

anya: ETA ~45m. Link-checker flagged 6 bad anchors and 3 outdated snippet files (go-old-snippet.go, ts-old-retry.ts, curl-old.sh). I'll replace them with standardized Go/TS/curl examples that show Retry-After and X-RW-Retry-Policy usage.

doc-bot: Automated scan summary: 6 broken links under /errref, 3 snippet files missing expected markers, 2 stream docs reference deprecated FIXME anchors. Full output: /tmp/errref-scan-492346.log

mike: I can update the Go snippet; prefer using context.WithTimeout + defer cancel and show the small prompt-trim helper.

jess: I'll handle the fallback copy. Proposal: split sections into "model-variant fallback" and "regional/capacity fallback" so readers know what to expect.

luis: Two requests: (1) call out streaming reconnection behavior (don't immediately retry a disconnected stream; use jittered backoff), (2) add a short note for Dedicated customers on private endpoint routing and auth quirks.

anya: Noted. Draft curl example for errref/migration guide below:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"very short prompt"}' \
  "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate?model=redwood-vicuna-13b"
```
Standardized retry headers I'm introducing in the examples:
```http
Retry-After: 3
X-RW-Retry-Policy: exponential, base=0.2, max=6
```
I'll add a tiny backoff loop in TS/Go showing parsing Retry-After and using an exponential jitter.

sam: Please add a PR checklist in the description so CI won't be surprised: 1) update snippets, 2) run link-checker, 3) run snippets:validate, 4) attach smoke test logs, 5) request eng/docs review.

jess: :thumbsup: Also add a minimal Node smoke test that asserts 429 handling and presence of Retry-After. I can polish UX copy after PR.

anya: Node smoke example I'll include (very short):
```js
const res = await fetch(url, { headers })
if (res.status === 429) {
  const ra = res.headers.get('retry-after') || '1'
  await sleep(Number(ra) * 1000)
}
```
I'll ensure the CI harness runs this as a smoke check.

doc-bot: CI note: "snippets:validate" will fail if marker tokens are absent or filenames change. Add label `docs:snippets-changed` to the PR.

mike: Quick Q: for the Go example, should we prefer context-based cancellation rather than raw time.Sleep? There are a few older snippets that ignore context.

luis: Yes, use context.WithTimeout + defer cancel and show a tiny prompt-trimmer util link to /docs/context-trimmer. Also include a line about refusing to auto-retry on 401/403 vs retrying on 429/503.

sam: I'll prioritize the review once the PR is up. If someone runs snippets harness pre-merge, ping me and I'll expedite.

jess: I'll preflight the UX copy and drop inline suggestions. Also will check the new headings for clarity.

anya: Thanks all. I'll open PR in ~40m, tag @mike @jess @sam and attach the checklist + smoke outputs. Will also update errref index to point to consolidated examples and migration checklist.
